CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF CHILDREN AND WOMEN

I. GENERAL

The implementation of protection for children and women is carried out based on the principles of humanity, integration and justice. So that every person must obtain their right to protection for a sense of security and be free from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity which is contrary to what is aspired to in the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, namely the creation of a just and civilized humanity.

In Article 2 of Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection that the implementation of Child Protection is based on Pancasila and grounded in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia as well as the basic principles of the Convention on the Rights of the Child including:

a. non-discrimination;
b. the best interests of the child;
c. the right to life, survival, and development; and d. respect for the views of the child.

In Article 3 of Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence that the elimination of domestic violence is carried out based on the principles of: a. respect for human rights; b. justice and gender equality,

c. non-discrimination; and d. victim protection.

In Article 3 of Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection that Child Protection aims to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from

JDIH Singkawang City violence and discrimination, for the realization of quality, noble and prosperous Indonesian children. In Article 4 of Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence that the elimination of domestic violence aims to: a. prevent all forms of domestic violence; b. protect victims of domestic violence;

c. prosecute perpetrators of domestic violence; and d. maintain the integrity of a harmonious and prosperous household. To realize law enforcement and the fulfillment of the human rights of children and women, the Singkawang City Government is obliged to provide protection from violence and discrimination as well as the fulfillment of civil rights and freedoms which are set forth in a policy at the regional level.

The establishment of a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Children and Women is an elaboration of higher legislation that regulates the rights of children and women. In the Regional Regulation on the Protection of Children and Women, the norms formulated are efforts to address the problems faced in the implementation of child and women protection in Singkawang City. The implementation of child and women protection is carried out to realize the fulfillment of the rights of children and women in accordance with human dignity and worth, and to receive protection from violence, discrimination, exploitation, and neglect for the realization of human resource development in Singkawang City that is faithful, intelligent, quality, noble and prosperous.

heading: Article 41

Pasal 41

Yang dimaksud dengan "lembaga negara lainnya" adalah kepolisian, kejaksaan, pengadilan, dan lembaga bantuan hukum.

Yang dimaksud dengan "dieksploitasi secara ekonomi" adalah meliputi tindakan atau perbuatanmemperalat, memanfaatkan, atau memeras anak untuk memperolehkeuntungan pribadi, keluarga, atau golongan.

Yang dimaksud dengan "Kekerasan fisik dan/atau mental" adalah perlakuan yang menyebabkan melukai dan/atau mencederai anak, dan tidak semata-mata fisik, tetapi juga mental dan sosial. Yang dimaksud dengan "perlakuan salah", adalah perbuatan atau tindakan pelecehan atau perbuatan tidak senonoh kepada anak. Yang dimaksud dengan "penelantaran" adalah tindakan atau perbuatan mengabaikan dengan sengaja kewajiban untuk memelihara, merawat, atau mengurus anak sebagaimana mestinya .
translated_text:
Article 41

What is meant by "other state institutions" are the police, prosecutor's office, courts, and legal aid institutions.

What is meant by "economically exploited" includes actions or deeds of instrumentalizing, utilizing, or extorting children to obtain personal, family, or group benefits.

What is meant by "Physical and/or mental violence" is treatment that causes injury and/or harm to children, and not merely physical, but also mental and social. What is meant by "maltreatment" is an act or action of indecency or indecent conduct toward a child. What is meant by "neglect" is an act or deed of deliberately neglecting the obligation to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate.
